d: A figure of indeterminate age and mature build, fully encased in a tactical, dark charcoal and slate grey combat suit accented with glowing crimson lines and red piping. The face is entirely hidden by a complex black mechanical mask featuring several glowing red circular ocular sensors and an integrated respirator. The attire consists of a hooded olive-drab cloak over a reinforced bodysuit, equipped with a chest rig of pouches, a utility belt, and asymmetrical leg armor including a heavy black plated greave on the right leg and a brown tactical boot on the left. Signature details include a large mechanical exoskeleton rig on the back holding a glowing orange energy blade, a handheld futuristic black and red firearm, and several white rectangular tags hanging from the left hand.
